name: upstream-oss
description: Records which open-source packages your coding agent really relied on and lets you pay their verified maintainers through PayPal.

server_url.title: Upstream server URL
server_url.description: The server's PUBLIC_BASE_URL, for example https://your-upstream.onrender.com

ingest_token.title: Ingest token
ingest_token.description: The server's INGEST_TOKEN. The hook sends it with every event, and the agent's tools use it to read this machine's session evidence back.

admin_token.title: Admin token (optional)
admin_token.description: The server's ADMIN_TOKEN. Only needed for the agent tools that plan payouts or request a top-up. Leave empty to keep the agent read-only.
